introduction: In Delhi, obtaining a Driving License (DL) is a structured process managed under the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways through the centralized national system. The process is divided into two main phases: obtaining a Learner's License (LLR) and subsequently obtaining the Permanent Driving License (DL).
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Process Flow: You must first obtain a Learner's License (LLR) before you can apply for a permanent Driving License (DL).
  • Time Limits: You can apply for a permanent DL only after a minimum gap of 1 month (30 days) from the date of LLR issuance, and it must be done within 6 months (LLR validity period).
  • Centralized Portal: The entire process is handled online via the official national Parivahan Sarathi website.
  • Learner Fee: The application fee for the Learner's License (LLR) is ₹150.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required Checklist

For Learner's License (LLR)
  • Aadhaar Card: Required for online e-KYC and authentication (must be linked to an active mobile number).
  • Address Proof: Aadhaar Card (front and back scanned into a single PDF).
  • Self-Declaration Form 1: Digital physical fitness declaration completed online.
  • LLR Test Documents: Printed application form, fee payment receipt, and Provisional Appointment Receipt.
For Permanent DL Test
  • Original Aadhaar Card and a Xerox copy.
  • Learner's License (LLR) Xerox copy.
  • Fee Payment Receipt & DL Test Appointment Receipt.
  • Vehicle & Safety: A helmet (mandatory for two-wheelers) and a vehicle in good condition with working indicator lights.
onlineApplication:
Phase 1: Applying for a Learner's License (LLR)

  1. Portal Access: Visit sarathi.parivahan.gov.in and select Delhi from the state dropdown menu.
  2. Start Application: Click on "Apply for Learner License" and then "Continue". Select "General" category, choose the option indicating you do not hold any driving/learner license in India, and click "Submit".
  3. Aadhaar Authentication: Choose "Submit via Aadhaar Authentication". Enter your Aadhaar number, generate and submit the OTP received on your Aadhaar-linked mobile number, accept the consent boxes, and click "Authenticate".
  4. Fill the Form: Click "Proceed" to import details from Aadhaar. Manually enter your relationship details (Father/Mother/Husband name), Place of Birth, Educational Qualification, Blood Group, Mobile Number, and Identification Marks. If addresses match Aadhaar, check the box and enter the years/months lived there.
  5. Vehicle Class Selection: Select the vehicle types (e.g., "Motor cycle without gear" for gearless scooters, "Motor cycle with gear (MCWG)" for geared motorcycles, or "Light Motor Vehicle (LMV)" for cars) and move them to the right column.
  6. Self-Declaration & Submission: Click the yellow "Self Declaration" button (Form 1). Complete the health questionnaire (typical pattern for a healthy person: No, Yes, No, No, No, No), submit it, declare your organ donation preference, and click "Submit" to generate your Application Number.
  7. Document Upload: Click "Next", select "Upload Documents" and "Proceed". Select "Address Proof" and choose "Aadhaar Card". Enter document details (Issued by: UIDAI, along with the issue date) and upload a single PDF containing both the front and back of your Aadhaar card.
  8. Fee Payment: Select "Fee Payment" and "Proceed". Choose the payment gateway (e.g., your state's payment gateway), enter the captcha, click "Pay Now", agree to the terms, and pay online. Print or save the payment receipt.
  9. Slot Booking: Go back to the homepage, select "Complete your Pending Application", enter your Application Number and Date of Birth, select "LL Slot Book", select an available green date and time, authenticate with OTP, and print the Provisional Appointment Receipt.

Phase 2: Applying for the Permanent Driving License (DL)

Note: You can only apply for a permanent DL after completing 30 days from the date your LLR was issued.

  1. Start DL Application: On the Sarathi homepage, click "Apply for Driving License". Enter your Learner's License Number and Date of Birth, select all the vehicle classes listed, and submit to generate your DL Application Number.
  2. Fee Payment & DL Slot Booking: Pay the DL fees online using the gateway. Then, navigate to "Appointments" > "DL Test Slot Booking" on the main menu. Enter your application details, choose an available green slot date/time, confirm with the OTP sent to your phone, and print the DL Test Appointment Receipt.
offlineApplication:
RTO Tests and Physical Verification

1. Taking the LLR Test at the RTO

Carry your Original Aadhaar and Xerox, Fee Payment Receipt, Printed Application Form, and Appointment Receipt. After document verification at the RTO, you will receive an SMS password to take the computer-based test on traffic rules. You must answer at least 12 out of 20 questions correctly (30 seconds per question) to pass. If you fail, you must wait 24 hours, pay a re-test fee online, and book a new slot.

2. The Driving Skill Test at the RTO

Attend the physical driving test on your booked slot date at the RTO track. You must bring your own helmet (for two-wheelers) and a vehicle in good working condition. You must drive on specific tracks (like an 8-shape for bikes or H-track for cars). Crucial Rule: You must turn on the correct indicator lights when taking turns on the track and turn them off immediately after. Maintain a speed limit of 20-30 km/h. If you fail, you must wait 7 days, pay a re-test fee online, and book a new slot.
afterApplying:
Downloading Certificates & Dispatch

Downloading the LLR

Upon passing the computer test, go to the "Learner License" tab on the Sarathi homepage, click "Print Learner License (Form3)", enter your details and OTP, and download the LLR PDF.

Downloading the DL

Once your DL is approved, navigate to the "Driving License" tab > "Print Driving License" to download the digital copy.

Physical Card Dispatch

The physical smart card Driving License will be dispatched via post directly to your Aadhaar-registered residential address within a few weeks of passing the driving skill test.
